work.title: Disc Altar with Keyboard
work.description: Vertical assemblage set against black ground, constructed from layered compact discs, blue tape strips, a computer keyboard, hanging cables, and orange-and-gold foil panels arranged in a symmetrical, altar-like format. Printed white-and-blue strips form a horizontal band at lower center, while three gold discs rest along the bottom edge beneath suspended wires.
work.composition: vertical altar with disc stack and keyboard mouth
